content.text: Haryana Ayush Counselling 2025 is the Haryana State Counselling carried out for admission to Ayush Courses: BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS. The counselling is conducted by the Shri Krishna AYUSH University, Kurukshetra , in Haryana for all the BAMS/BHMS government/ Aided/ Private colleges, including those under Private/ Deemed Universities. NEET-UG qualified candidates can participate in the SKAU online counselling under either or both state quota and All India Quota, depending on the domicile of the candidate.
NEET-UG 2025 was held on 4 May 2025; NEET-G 2025 results were published on 14 June 2025. Haryana Ayush registration dates are yet to be announced officially.

Haryana Ayush Counselling is conducted by the Shri Krishna AYUSH University, Kurukshetra , for Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses. Admission is offered to the BAMS and BHMS government/ government-aided/ private institutes, including those under private/ deemed universities in Haryana, recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH).

https://skau.ac.in/ is the Haryana Ayush Counselling official website, where the candidates must register themselves to initiate the SKAU online counselling. NEET-UG qualification along with 10+2 higher secondary education in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects is mandatory for Haryana Ayush Counselling.

The majority of Ayush seats in Haryana are reserved for domicile students under the State Quota of 85% seats. And the remaining 15% seats are open to all candidates, including non-domicile /non-resident candidates under the All India Quota (AIQ). All the seats counselling for AIQ under private and government colleges are conducted by the AACCC . There is 1 BHMS college and 15 BAMS colleges in Haryana participating in the Haryana Ayush Counselling 2025.
